title: phyllanthus cuneifolius
intro: Phyllanthus cuneifolius, commonly known as the small-leaved phyllanthus, is a species of plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is a shrub-like plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of liver function. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus cuneifolius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties. While there is limited research on the plant, it is believed to have potential in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including liver disease and certain cancers.
